# We need Prod_id from df0 and df4
# We need Ship_id from df0 and df2
# We need Cust_id from df0 and df3

# Join df2 on Ship_id to ensure Ship_id keys exist (not strictly needed for target columns, but to ensure integrity)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_39/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_39/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_39/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_39/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_39/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on Ord_id
df = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Ord_id", how="inner")

# Join with Source2 on Ship_id
df = pd.merge(df, source2, on="Ship_id", how="inner")

# Join with Source3 on Cust_id
df = pd.merge(df, source3, on="Cust_id", how="inner")

# Join with Source4 on Prod_id
df = pd.merge(df, source4, on="Prod_id", how="inner")

# Select and rename columns to match target schema
# Target schema: ['Product_Category': string, 'Ord_id': string, 'Prod_id': integer, 'Ship_id': integer, 'Cust_id': integer]

# Convert Prod_id, Ship_id, Cust_id to integer by extracting the numeric part after underscore
def extract_int(col):
    return col.str.split('_').str[1].astype(int)

df["Prod_id"] = extract_int(df["Prod_id"])
df["Ship_id"] = extract_int(df["Ship_id"])
df["Cust_id"] = extract_int(df["Cust_id"])

# Group by all target columns to remove duplicates (if any)
df = df.groupby(["Product_Category", "Ord_id", "Prod_id", "Ship_id", "Cust_id"], as_index=False).size()

# Drop the aggregation column 'size' since no aggregation is needed, just distinct rows
df = df.drop(columns=["size"])

# Write to output CSV
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_39/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
